events.body:
## Context

`public/community.html` `#search-profiles` has only a placeholder (its icon isn't `aria-hidden`) and `#filter-experience` has no label. `public/index.html` `#error-message` has no `role="alert"`.

## What to do

1. Add labels/aria-labels and `aria-hidden` on the icon.
2. Add `role="alert"` to `#error-message`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Controls have accessible names
- [ ] Errors are announced

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-ossh/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```

---
